body: Review posted at coordination post-01M159X0E9MWTRBZFH9NDEJVTS. Header/length math is sound and cross-platform; no JVM-only primitive blocks JS. One HIGH: generic V is not bound to FeatureValueSchema, so scalar/vector wires can decode under the wrong V and dimension-one cases can materialize with a lying schema. Add a closed numeric witness or specialized factories/decoders plus cross-type rejection tests. One MEDIUM: expose checked layout/offset math for the Scala.js typed-array adapter; decodeRows is intentionally copying and should remain the portable materializer.
